scope: AEMO NEMWeb; four 28-day seasonal test folds per region; prior 28-day calibration and at least 30 earlier training days; forecast-only dispatch and actual-price settlement
risk_observation: At 50 AUD/MWh discharged, daily net-margin P05 was negative in all five regions. Tail and calibration failures vary materially by region and season.
economic_boundary: Historical spot-market operating-margin proxy only. Cycling cost is user supplied, not an asset-specific degradation model. Excludes CAPEX, fixed O&M, network fees, FCAS, bidding/settlement complexity and investment returns.
merge_gate: five unique regions; identical git SHA, input SHA256, degradation costs, scope and coverage
